title: Frozen Standard10 legacy-observation bridge greedy fresh20k confirmation
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The exact generic legacy-observation bridge will reproduce the historical Standard10 near-zero external regime on a fully independent fresh20k cohort. A positive point estimate with at least four of eight positive sessions admits a separate fresh100k qualification; a nonpositive point closes direct qualification and preserves the bridge only as initialization/reference.
material_change: Freeze the identical Standard10 checkpoint and already audited bridge runtime, then run eight independent fresh2500 generic-greedy Slumbot sessions with new seeds and IDs. No training, tactical overrides, nearest-action repair, retry, resume, or failed-hand replacement.
baseline: Bridge fresh5k: -15.79 bb/100 CI[-46.7802,15.2002], 4/8 positive. Historical old-contract fresh20k: -11.4275 CI[-28.7124,5.8574]. Naive v6 rebound fresh5k: -96.6832.
notes: The fresh20k cohort is independent of all previous sessions and uses the same frozen checkpoint plus bridge contract. Outcome evidence will not alter the fixed cohort.

result.summary: The exact frozen Standard10 legacy-observation bridge completed eight independent fresh2500 generic-greedy sessions: -24.5683 bb/100, raw 95% CI [-42.8407,-6.2959], session-t7 CI [-41.4361,-7.7005], and 1/8 positive sessions. Bridge-aware frozen-model replay, raw CI, token/evidence, and observable deal-stream independence audits all passed.
result.conclusion: Exact preservation of the historical Standard10 execution contract removes much of the naive v6 rebound loss but remains significantly losing on a new 20k cohort. The direct bridge is not a qualification candidate and the historical -11.4275 point estimate was optimistic within uncertainty. This does not support imitation-only training; future work must improve learned weights under a preservation-compatible observation contract.
result.next_step: Do not allocate fresh100k. Audit and implement a default-off v6 physical-rules plus legacy-v4 observation training mode so PPO/self-play can start from Standard10 without destroying its useful execution contract; first require exact rollout/inference parity and a small matched training smoke.
